name: Misbette
source:
An elegant warcat with a beastly heart.

"Ah... Why am I always like this...?"

A bright and lovely girl in cooperation with Gran, who will perform the princess's training ritual.

She tries to act ladylike, but her genuine personality appears whenever she gets flustered. She will show her cold side to her prey, like a hunter.

She possesses the power of "Physical Manipulation" which sharpens her senses and transforms her body into a beast. Her curse changed her from a lady to a "Warcat" beast, and she hated it because her looks became unladylike when it came to her identity.

She is searching for "something" she has lost in the past while cooperating with the ritual.

[Translated from [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/testament/chara03.html]official website[/url]]
